explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/235 (Hooley). For primorials N_k, the proportion of gaps between consecutive reduced residues that are ≤ c·N_k/φ(N_k) converges, for each c ≥ 0, to a limit f(c) that is continuous on [0,∞). Indexing N_k as the product of the first k + 1 primes does not affect the limit. Formal proof linked.
